cases.name: Elizabeth Helen Boone
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She spent her adult years creating a family of her own and experiencing adventure in Alaska and then in Idaho. She was passionate about nourishing her family, cultivating her gardens, cherishing her recipes, and aiding her friends and neighbors. Liz selflessly and lovingly dedicated herself to the enrichment of the lives of her three children, and in her later years warmly devoted herself to her seven grandchildren. She performed diligently in technology and material purchasing roles. She honorably served her community as Woodbridge HOA President for many years. She edified the lives of many and made an impact upon those who knew her well.
cases.narrative: Shot in head with .45 cal handgun.
